pages.title: ORSA Thermal Survey Optic
pages.text: $(bold)Recovered designation:$() Surveyor Lens.$(br2)The Returned Architect carried optics tuned to infrastructure instead of faces. ORSA engineers have repurposed one into a field scanner for detecting $(bold)active thermal anchors$() underground.$(br2)$(italic)Translation: the monster's eye now helps you find the one heater you forgot to refuel.$()

pages.title: Field Use
pages.text: $(bold)Acquisition:$() Returned Architects occasionally drop a $(item)Surveyor Lens$().$(br2)$(bold)Passive mode:$() Hold it in hand or offhand to bring up a thermal wash over your visor. Nearby heat infrastructure is marked automatically.$(br2)$(bold)Ping:$() Right-click to pulse for nearby $(l:advanced/geothermal_core)Geothermal Cores$(/l), lit Thermal Heaters, $(l:advanced/acheron_forge)Acheron Forges$(/l), and ORSA Transponders.$(br2)$(italic)It still does not detect lava, bad decisions, or Kevin from Logistics.$()
